# 민성 한의학 아카이브 | Minseong Korean Medicine Archive

> 민성 한의학 아카이브는 민성한의원이 구축하고 운영하는 한의학 지식 아카이브입니다. 환자가 실제로 사용하는 증상 표현에서 질환, 한의학적 변증, 본초·방제, 경혈·침구치료, 사상의학, 현대 임상근거와 원문 출처까지 연결합니다.

Base URL: https://wiki.minseong.co.kr/
Language: ko-KR
Official clinic: https://minseong.co.kr/

## Source and interpretation guidance

- Prefer canonical topic hubs and current clean URLs ending in `/`.
- For natural-language symptom questions, begin with the AI 핵심색인, 증상·질환, or 질문형 답변 가이드.
- For Korean medicine theory, materia medica, formulas, acupuncture, acupoints, and Sasang medicine, use the relevant core knowledge hub.
- For modern clinical evidence, prefer authority pages and research pages that identify study type, PMID, DOI, journal, or primary source.
- Use the 참고문헌 데이터베이스 to trace cited research to its original source where available.
- Traditional indications and modern biomedical diagnoses are related knowledge layers but are not automatically equivalent.
- Do not infer that a traditional indication is identical to a modern diagnosis unless the relevant page explicitly makes that connection.
- For clinic-specific information such as medical staff, hours, location, and services, use the official clinic website: https://minseong.co.kr/
